frozen_candidate_root_contribution: لذذ contributes consummated, recipient-relative sensory pleasure: the gratification a perceiving/consuming faculty realizes in a present object. The nominal laḏḏah names the object's pleasure-giving quality anchored to a recipient (li-l-šāribīn); the Form-I verb talaḏḏu names the faculty's own act of enjoying (al-aʿyun as subject). These are two diatheses of one pleasure-relation — source-is-pleasing / faculty-is-pleased. The nucleus is faculty-general (taste and sight both attested), always relational (never a perceiver-independent absolute property), and distinct from appetitive wanting.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: In all three occurrences the root marks actual, enjoyed pleasure delivered to a person's sense-faculty by something present. Twice it is the noun laḏḏah ('a pleasure') predicated of a paradisiacal drink and pinned to its drinkers (37:46, 47:15); once it is the verb 'the eyes take pleasure' (43:71). The root does not mean the flavor of a drink specifically, nor the desire/craving that precedes enjoyment — 43:71 keeps laḏḏ (delighting) explicitly distinct from shahw (craving) in the same clause.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT craving/appetite/lack — explicitly contrasted with تشتهيه الأنفس (root sh-h-w) in 43:71, where laḏḏ is pleasure in present having, not the wanting that precedes it. NOT sense-specific (attested for taste and for sight), so not 'deliciousness/flavor.' NOT a perceiver-independent intrinsic property — both nouns carry لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ and the verb has an explicit faculty subject, so the pleasure is always indexed to an experiencer/beneficiary. NOT the act of consuming or desiring — those are borne by other roots (شرب, شهو) in the same contexts. NOT demonstrable from this packet: any licit/illicit or worldly/otherworldly restriction — all three tokens are the eschatological-reward register, which is absence of contrary data, not a proven exclusion (absence != proof).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 43:71:11:2 «وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ» ('and the eyes take pleasure'). It is the only verb, the only sight-modality token, and the only case where the faculty (al-aʿyun) is the grammatical experiencer rather than the pleasure being predicated of an object. It defeats any narrow 'delicious-drink' account by shifting modality (taste->sight), argument orientation (object-as-pleasure->faculty-as-experiencer), and form (nominal->finite verb). It does not break the unified account — it in fact confirms the faculty-general pleasure nucleus and, via the coordinated مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ, supplies the sharpest internal distinction of laḏḏ (consummated pleasure) from shahw (appetitive craving). It disciplines how narrow the account may go without refuting it.

Strength is capped below STRONG for three contract-relevant reasons: (1) breadth failure — n=3 with effective n≈2, since 37:46 and 47:15 are the same laḏḏah lil-šāribīn collocation; (2) a lexicalized/nominal sub-class (the drink-epithet) exists, which under the contract caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE even though it is transparent and non-resistant; (3) single register only (Paradise reward), so the account cannot be adversarially stressed against worldly/negative pleasure. The nominal laḏḏah names the object's pleasure-giving quality anchored to a recipient (li-l-šāribīn); the Form-I verb talaḏḏu names the faculty's own act of enjoying (al-aʿyun as subject). layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 3/3 tokens (full coverage): laḏḏah predicated of a drink with li-l-šāribīn at 37:46:2:1 and 47:15:21:1 (ADJ, taste); talaḏḏu with al-aʿyun as experiencer-subject at 43:71:11:2 (V, sight).
layer_attribution.derivation: Two diatheses of one root: nominal laḏḏah (object's pleasure-giving quality, recipient-anchored) and Form-I imperfect talaḏḏu (faculty's act of enjoying). Converse orientations of a single pleasure-relation; the bridge between them is inferred, not slot-linked.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A lexicalized/collocational nominal sub-class (laḏḏah lil-šāribīn, drink-epithet) accounts for both ADJ tokens as effectively one environment; transparent, non-resistant, but breadth-limiting and strength-capping.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: All three sit in the eschatological Paradise-reward frame (cup, rivers of wine, the eyes' delight). This register is contextual/narrative and is NOT elevated into the root claim — the root contributes 'consummated recipient-relative faculty-pleasure,' not 'paradisiacal pleasure.'
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No preliminary/final disposition conflicts arose; all occurrences classify as CONSISTENT under one nucleus. The lone hard case (43:71) is reconciled as an adversarial boundary that confirms rather than resists the account.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: None as outright resistance. Residual under-determination: the noun/verb bridge is inferred not demonstrated, and the single register prevents adversarial stress-testing — the reasons strength is held at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_cases.reason: The only verb / only sight token / only faculty-as-subject case; it both disciplines the account (forcing abstraction above 'delicious drink' to 'gratification of a perceiving faculty') and supplies the sharpest negative boundary by being coordinated with, yet held distinct from, the craving root sh-h-w (تشتهيه الأنفس).

evidence_basis.statement: In 43:71 «وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ» the pleasure-relation shifts to sight with the faculty (al-aʿyun) as experiencer-subject, and the coordinated مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ keeps laḏḏ (realized delight) explicitly distinct from sh-h-w (appetitive craving); this defeats a narrow gustatory reading and fixes the nucleus as faculty-general, consummated, recipient-relative pleasure — while the noun/verb bridge remains inferred, not slot-linked.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence is finally RESISTANT — all three cohere with one nucleus. The single genuine hard case is 43:71:11:2, which functions as an adversarial boundary (distinguishing laḏḏ from sh-h-w) and a structural atypicality (only verb, only sight, only faculty-subject), and it disciplines rather than breaks the account. Its evidence_basis statement is echoed in strongest_counterexample and the verb-cluster note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: An occurrence of لذذ (noun laḏḏah or a verb of the root) where the root denotes appetitive wanting/pursuit of something absent, or a perceiver-independent absolute property with no recipient/experiencer, or a worldly/illicit/negative pleasure — any of which would break the 'consummated, recipient-relative, faculty-realized pleasure' nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: Beyond this 3-token packet: any further attestations of ل ذ ذ in non-paradisiacal or non-reward registers, and any token structurally linking the two argument slots (e.g. drinkers as verbal subject of talaḏḏu, or laḏḏah predicated of a perceiving faculty).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each new occurrence with QAC morphology (qac_pos, form) and full verse_text; test whether the pleasure is realized-in-having vs desired-in-absence, and whether a recipient/experiencer is grammatically obligatory.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Distinguish register/context (Paradise imagery) from root contribution — do not let the eschatological setting be read into the root. Separate l-dh-dh from co-occurring roots sh-h-w (craving) and shrb (drinking). Treat 37:46 and 47:15 as one collocation, not two independent data.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If appetitive, absolute, or negative-register uses appear, downgrade to LOCAL/UNRESOLVED or split into classes; if a slot-linking token appears, the inferred noun/verb bridge becomes demonstrated and strength could rise toward STRONG.

reopen_conditions: A new attestation of ل ذ ذ outside the paradisiacal-reward register (e.g. worldly, blameworthy, or negated pleasure) that would test whether the recipient-relative consummated-pleasure nucleus is register-bound.

A token structurally linking the two argument slots — e.g. the drinkers (šāribīn) as the verbal subject of talaḏḏu, or laḏḏah predicated of a perceiving faculty — which would convert the inferred noun/verb diathesis bridge into a demonstrated one.

Any further token that coordinates or contrasts l-dh-dh with sh-h-w (craving) or with a consumption root, testing whether the laḏḏ = realized-delight vs shahw = appetitive-wanting boundary generalizes beyond 43:71.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: No occurrence resists the nucleus, so falsification did not FAIL. But a clean PASS is not warranted: the noun/verb bridge is inferred rather than Quran-internally demonstrated (no slot-linking token), the two noun tokens are one collocation, and the unified nucleus must abstract to 'gratification of a perceiving faculty' to cover all three — weakening distinctiveness. Hence NOT_RUN with the limitation recorded, not PASSED.
